Iniciar al entrar en Linux: Start when logging in to Linux
El audio solo permanece en RAM. Hasta do: Audio stays in RAM only. Up to two minutes per dictation.
La posición de la cápsula depende del es: Capsule placement depends on your desktop. This version uses notifications without taking focus.
Enter se omite si el escritorio no permi: Enter is skipped when the desktop cannot verify focus and modifiers. You can always copy your text.
Conecta el atajo desde Ajustes y elige l: Enable the shortcut in Settings and choose your combination in the desktop dialog.
Pulsa otra vez el atajo para cancelar el: Press the shortcut again to cancel processing. Esc cancels inside Senda.
No se pudo conectar el atajo. Puedes gra: Could not connect the shortcut. You can record from Senda.
No se puede comprobar el destino. El res: The destination cannot be verified. Your result will be available to copy.
Sin acceso al almacén de claves: el hist: Keyring unavailable: history will not be saved.
El historial no se pudo leer y se conser: History could not be read and was preserved unchanged.
Entrega de texto aceptada por el campo d: Text insertion accepted by the destination field.
Enter omitido: no se pueden verificar lo: Enter skipped: modifier state cannot be verified.
El motor local se cerró. Vuelve a pulsar: The local engine stopped. Press Record again to restart it.
El escritorio no autorizó el inicio auto: The desktop did not authorize autostart.
Encrypted history could not be saved.
La corrección se copia para pegarla manu: Corrections are copied for manual pasting; sent messages are not replaced.
El catálogo permite volver a descargar m: Deleted models remain available in the catalog. Medium and Turbo need more memory and can be slower on CPU. Downloading a model sets it as default. Changing only this selector does not change the active model.
